resources.string: Play multichannel music supplied by the app through the car’s sound system. Requires support from the app and the track. Reconnect CarPlay after changing this setting.
This version or car does not support spatial audio. You can still play regular music. Reconnect CarPlay after changing this setting.
Pass multichannel music supplied by the app through Dolby processing before playback. Turn on Spatial audio first; stereo music is unaffected. Reconnect CarPlay after changing this setting.
